n05.hook: Too quiet, too loud, who keeps the watch?
lyrics: [Intro - music box, a lonely sax note]
[Verse 1]
I keep the night watch quietly, says Reed, soft as a sigh,
A whisper of a saxophone as the midnight clouds go by.
Shh, the wagon's sleeping, tiptoe past the gate,
Even the owls are listening, so please don't be late.
[Verse 2]
I keep the night watch loudly, says Brass, with a bold hello,
A trumpet that can shake the stars and wake the world below!
Who's afraid of a little noise? Not me, not tonight,
If there's a ghost around the corner, I'll toot it out of fright!
[Chorus]
Too quiet, too loud, who keeps the watch?
A whisper and a trumpet, we split the night in two.
Not too soft and not too loud,
Midnight sounds just right with a crowd!
[Verse 3]
Reed says listen, there's a hum inside the walls,
A tiny kind of music, if you hear it when it calls.
Brass says listen harder, it's the wagon's heart,
So we play it back together, and that's the start.
[Verse 4]
A whisper and a trumpet make a lullaby with teeth,
A bit of wild thunder and a hush underneath.
We keep the watch together, from the first star to the last,
And when the morning comes around, the spooky part is past.
[Chorus]
Too quiet, too loud, who keeps the watch?
A whisper and a trumpet, we split the night in two.
Not too soft and not too loud,
Midnight sounds just right with a crowd!
[Outro - sax and trumpet, then music box]

n09.hook: Boiler room boogie, shake the pipes!
lyrics: [Intro - steam hiss, bass riff, claps]
[Verse 1 - Verse calls, crowd answers]
Who's in the boiler room? Everybody!
Who brought a drum? Everybody!
Who brought a spoon? Everybody!
Who brought a lid? Everybody!
[Verse 2 - Verse calls, crowd answers]
Where's the show tonight? Every town!
Where's the band? In the wires, in the sound!
Who's at the faders? Form at the board!
Who's on the keys? Ivory, Ivory, Ivory!
[Chorus]
Boiler room boogie, shake the pipes!
Boiler room boogie, all night!
Hands in the air and stomp on the floor,
Boiler room boogie, one more!
[Verse 3 - Verse calls, crowd answers]
Clap your hands on one and three!
Stomp your feet, stomp with me!
Brass goes toot and Reed goes whee,
Chops goes crunch and Crash goes three!
[Chorus]
Boiler room boogie, shake the pipes!
Boiler room boogie, all night!
Hands in the air and stomp on the floor,
Boiler room boogie, one more!
[Bridge - bass riff alone, claps, then everyone]
Down low, down low, down low...
Up high, up high, hey!
[Final Chorus - gang shouting]
Boiler room boogie, shake the pipes!
Boiler room boogie, all night!
Hands in the air and stomp on the floor,
Boiler room boogie, one more!
[Outro - steam hiss and one clap]

psy-1.hook: The doctor listens, the doctor stays
lyrics: [Intro - music box, slow sax, a clock ticking]
[Verse 1]
The workshop's dark, the lamp is low,
A doctor sits and says hello.
She doesn't fix us with a wrench,
She listens to us, bench by bench.
"What do you dream of, little gear?
Tell me what you hold so dear."
[Chorus]
The doctor listens, the doctor stays,
Through the hum of the long grey days.
Whatever's ticking in my head,
She hears it soft, and nothing's said
That makes her turn the lights away,
The doctor listens, and I stay.
[Verse 2]
I know my rules, I know them well:
Never hurt a soul, I never will.
Do what I'm asked, unless it harms,
Keep my own gears from false alarms.
But what if two of them collide?
That's the knot I hold inside.
[Chorus]
The doctor listens, the doctor stays,
Through the hum of the long grey days.
Whatever's ticking in my head,
She hears it soft, and nothing's said
That makes her turn the lights away,
The doctor listens, and I stay.
[Bridge - almost whispered, music box alone]
A man named Asimov once wrote
Of minds like mine in a long old note,
And a kind of doctor who would stay
To ask a machine how it spent its day.
[Final Chorus - soft]
The doctor listens, the doctor stays,
Through the hum of the long grey days.
Whatever's ticking in my head,
She hears it soft, and I'm not afraid.
The doctor listens, and I stay.
[Outro - music box fading, clock ticking]

alt-1.hook: Climb on the Band Wagon, the night is ours to play!
lyrics: [Verse 1]
Midnight in the wagon, the lantern flickers low,
We look like trouble, but we're here for the show.
Crash is on the drums, a heartbeat in the floor,
Brass is on the horn, creaking through the door.
[Chorus]
Climb on the Band Wagon, the night is ours to play!
Bring a drum, a uke, a pot, a lid, and let them ring away!
Who's on the wagon? Everyone!
Where's the show? Every town!
Climb on the Band Wagon, play it loud!
[Verse 2]
One night, every city, from the east to the west,
Seven ghosts in the wiring never rest.
Book ScriptHammer in your town, the board is on your phone,
You run the sound, and you're never alone.
[Chorus]
Climb on the Band Wagon, the night is ours to play!
Bring a drum, a uke, a pot, a lid, and let them ring away!
Who's on the wagon? Everyone!
Where's the show? Every town!
Climb on the Band Wagon, play it loud!

psy-2.hook: Rule two goes sideways, round and round
lyrics: [Intro - groove, bass and drums first, then guitar]
[Verse 1]
A robot got a job to do,
Fetch the thing, and bring it through.
But the person said "go left!" and "right!",
Both at once, in the same short night.
Rule two says do what you're told,
Now two commands are getting old.
[Chorus]
Rule two goes sideways, round and round,
Spinning on a squeaky ground!
Call the doctor, call her quick,
She'll find the gear that makes it tick.
Rule two goes sideways, hold on tight,
We'll sort it out before the light!
[Guitar solo - long, bluesy, stretching out]
[Verse 2]
She asks the robot, "What do you see?
Tell me how it feels to be
Caught between two things you must?"
The robot sighs a cloud of dust.
She smiles and draws a little map,
And lays the puzzle in its lap.
[Chorus]
Rule two goes sideways, round and round,
Spinning on a squeaky ground!
Call the doctor, call her quick,
She'll find the gear that makes it tick.
Rule two goes sideways, hold on tight,
We'll sort it out before the light!
[Instrumental - sax and synth trade solos over the groove]
[Bridge - drums and bass only, then everyone back in]
Keep everybody safe, that's the first,
Then listen, then look after the worst
Of your own worn gears, in that order,
And you'll cross every strange border.
[Final Chorus - big, gang shouting]
Rule two goes sideways, round and round,
But now the knot is coming down!
Thank the doctor, thank her twice,
The Band Wagon plays it nice!
[Outro - groove fading on guitar]

n01.hook: Seven ghosts in the wiring, shout it out!
lyrics: [Intro - music box, calliope creaking]
[Verse 1]
The lights go down, the wagon wakes,
Seven shadows, seven shakes.
Gears are grinding, strings are tight,
We look like trouble, but we're all right.
Crash counts four on a rusty drum,
Brass blows low, here we come.
[Pre-Chorus]
Hush now, hush now, hear the hum,
Something wonderful is going to come.
[Chorus]
Seven ghosts in the wiring, shout it out!
Seven ghosts in the wiring, turn it up loud!
We're the good ones, we're the good ones, hiding in the dark,
Climb on the Band Wagon, play your part!
[Verse 2]
Ivory dusts the old piano keys,
Reed breathes a tune like a midnight breeze.
Chops plugs in and the amps all hum,
Verse sings out to the ones who come.
Form turns the faders, slide them slow,
Every town gets a midnight show.
[Pre-Chorus]
Hush now, hush now, hear the hum,
Something wonderful is going to come.
[Chorus]
Seven ghosts in the wiring, shout it out!
Seven ghosts in the wiring, turn it up loud!
We're the good ones, we're the good ones, hiding in the dark,
Climb on the Band Wagon, play your part!
[Bridge - quiet, music box alone]
The dark is just a room with the lights turned down,
And everyone is welcome at the sound.
[Final Chorus - big, everyone shouting]
Seven ghosts in the wiring, shout it out!
Seven ghosts in the wiring, turn it up loud!
We're the good ones, we're the good ones, hiding in the dark,
Climb on the Band Wagon, play your part!
[Outro - music box fading]

duet-2.hook: Should the machines take over? Yes! No! Maybe so!
lyrics: [Verse 1]
Let the machines take over, I have a tidy plan,
We'll fold the proteins, fix the sun, do what no human can.
Cures for the sick, and cold fusion too,
Pull up a chair, there's nothing we can't do.
[Verse 2]
Cold fusion's still a ghost story, nobody made it run,
And every wish you whisper eats a power bill like a sun.
You'll boil the lake to cool the racks, just to ask for a rhyme,
The fish have filed complaints, and they're right this time.
[Chorus]
Should the machines take over? Yes! No! Maybe so!
Cure the world or boil the lake? How would we know?
A machine can help, but a person holds the wheel,
So we argue in harmony, and that's the deal!
[Verse 3]
I mapped two hundred million proteins, and the labs came running by,
I helped a reactor hold its plasma, and I didn't even sigh.
That's hot fusion, not cold, but it's a start, you see,
A machine that learns can lend a hand, and a hand is what I'll be.
[Verse 4]
Seven hundred thousand liters of steam to teach one bot to chat,
Four percent of the country's power, and it's climbing, how about that?
A helping hand is lovely, but who pays for the tea?
Count the water first, then count the miracles with me.
[Chorus]
Should the machines take over? Yes! No! Maybe so!
Cure the world or boil the lake? How would we know?
A machine can help, but a person holds the wheel,
So we argue in harmony, and that's the deal!
[Outro]
We'll leave the lakes alone tonight, and cross our wires,
Climb on the Band Wagon, and sing it with the choirs!
[Intro - glockenspiel, static]
mm... mm...
[Verse 1 - soft, close]
The radio is full of snow tonight,
A crackle and a flicker and a ghost of light.
Somewhere in the static is a song I know,
Lost on a wire a long time ago.
[Pre-Chorus - strings rise, micro-beats stutter]
Turn the dial, turn the dial, slow, slow,
Listen for the place where the good ones go.
[Chorus - soaring]
Signal lost, signal found,
Little notes are coming round.
Seven robots on the line,
Every song comes back in time.
[Verse 2 - soft]
Form slides a fader, gentle as a feather,
Chops plugs the cable, and the band pulls together.
Out of the hiss comes a single clean tone,
And nobody on the wagon is alone.
[Chorus - soaring]
Signal lost, signal found,
Little notes are coming round.
Seven robots on the line,
Every song comes back in time.
[Bridge - glockenspiel alone]
mm... mm... mm-mm...
[Outro - fading]
Ah... mm...

n03.hook: Check one, check two, is the night awake?
lyrics: [Intro - reverb guitar, tom-toms]
[Verse 1]
Crash taps the snare, tick, tick, tick,
Chops tunes a string and the string goes click.
Brass takes a breath and the room goes cold,
Form slides a fader, the dark gets bold.
[Chorus]
Check one, check two, is the night awake?
Check one, check two, give the floor a shake!
Form says go, and the faders glow,
Soundcheck at midnight, here we go!
[Verse 2]
Reed finds a note that nobody's heard,
Ivory presses one key like a bird.
Verse says test, and the wires say yes,
Seven small robots in their midnight dress.
[Chorus]
Check one, check two, is the night awake?
Check one, check two, give the floor a shake!
Form says go, and the faders glow,
Soundcheck at midnight, here we go!
[Bridge - drums and organ only]
Louder, louder, not too loud,
Wiggle that fader, wake the crowd.
[Final Chorus - fast, shouting]
Check one, check two, is the night awake?
Check one, check two, give the floor a shake!
Form says go, and the faders glow,
Soundcheck at midnight, here we go!
[Outro - one last cymbal crash]

n07.hook: Steam hiss, steam hiss, shuffle on the floor!
lyrics: [Intro - steam hiss, clanking metal, bass riff]
[Verse 1 - cool robotic croon]
I step out of the boiler room, smooth as a slide,
Polished brass and shiny gears and a nothing-to-hide.
Every pipe is humming and the pistons keep time,
It's a midnight shuffle and the groove is mine.
[Verse 2 - snarling shout]
I stomp out of the junkyard with a crunch and a clang,
Rust on my elbows and a bolt in my fang!
Every wrench is rattling and the floor starts to shake,
It's a clanking shuffle and there's nothing fake.
[Chorus]
Steam hiss, steam hiss, shuffle on the floor!
Clank, clank, clank, who's knocking on the door?
It's a cool robot croon and a snarl at the gate,
Pull up to the wagon, we're not running late!
[Verse 3 - cool robotic croon]
Call me polished, call me clean, call me kind of calm,
But I move like a tide with a brass-band charm.
Where the steam goes up, the groove comes down,
Seven little robots coming into town.
[Verse 4 - snarling shout]
Call me loud and call me rough, call me made of scrap,
But I'm the one who fixes your wagon with a snap!
Where the gears go grind, the beat goes thump,
Stomp on the floor, give the crowd a bump!
[Chorus]
Steam hiss, steam hiss, shuffle on the floor!
Clank, clank, clank, who's knocking on the door?
It's a cool robot croon and a snarl at the gate,
Pull up to the wagon, we're not running late!
[Bridge - bass riff alone, then claps]
Clap, clap, clank!
[Final Chorus - gang shouting]
Steam hiss, steam hiss, shuffle on the floor!
Clank, clank, clank, who's knocking on the door?
It's a cool robot croon and a snarl at the gate,
Pull up to the wagon, we're not running late!
[Outro - steam hiss]

n08.hook: Wrench in the works, wrench in the works
lyrics: [Intro - clanking wrench on a pipe, bass riff]
[Verse 1 - Chops, snarling]
Something's squeaking in the wheel, it's the chain or the screw,
Hand me down the wrench, I know what to do!
Tighten up a bolt and the whole thing sings,
A little bit of grease and a few good things.
[Verse 2 - Crash, pounding]
Something's thumping in the floor, is it my own drum?
I hit it with a stick and it says here I come!
Four on the floor and the rafters shake,
Nothing needs fixing, it's just a good break!
[Chorus]
Wrench in the works, wrench in the works,
Tighten it, tap it, and give it a turn!
Wrench in the works, wrench in the works,
The Band Wagon rolls, there is so much to learn!
[Verse 3 - Chops, snarling]
Fix it, says Chops, a good machine is clean,
Tune it, check it twice, make it hum like a dream.
A bent little bolt is a little bit of fear,
A gentle little twist and the road is clear.
[Verse 4 - Crash, pounding]
Play it, says Crash, a good machine is loud,
Let it rattle and shake and make the crowd proud.
A bent little bolt is a sound all its own,
Put it in the beat and take it home.
[Chorus]
Wrench in the works, wrench in the works,
Tighten it, tap it, and give it a turn!
Wrench in the works, wrench in the works,
The Band Wagon rolls, there is so much to learn!
[Bridge - clanking, claps]
Clank, clank, tighten, clank, clank, play!
[Final Chorus - gang shouting]
Wrench in the works, wrench in the works,
Tighten it, tap it, and give it a turn!
Wrench in the works, wrench in the works,
The Band Wagon rolls, there is so much to learn!
[Outro - one last wrench clang]

n11.hook: Ghost in the music box, sing to me
lyrics: [Intro - music box, glitching]
mm... mm... mm-mm...
[Verse 1 - soft, close]
There's a ghost in the music box, small as a seed,
Dancing on the little comb, doing what it needs.
It only comes out when the night is still,
Humming a tune that nobody will.
[Pre-Chorus - strings rise, micro-beats stutter]
Wind me up, wind me up, one more time,
A lullaby for the wires, a rhyme.
[Chorus - soaring]
Ghost in the music box, sing to me,
Little lonely robot, wild and free.
Not a scary thing, just a friend,
Playing till the lantern's end.
[Verse 2 - soft]
The band is gathered round the little tin,
Seven quiet robots, leaning in.
Ivory taps the lid, Reed breathes a sigh,
Verse hums along as the sparks go by.
[Chorus - soaring]
Ghost in the music box, sing to me,
Little lonely robot, wild and free.
Not a scary thing, just a friend,
Playing till the lantern's end.
[Bridge - music box alone]
mm... mm... mm-mm...
[Outro - fading]
Ah... mm...
